name: ATM Withdrawal Completion Advice V 03
definition: The ATMWithdrawalCompletionAdvice message is sent by an ATM to an acquirer or its agent to inform of the result of a withdrawal transaction at an ATM.|If the ATM is configured to only send negative completion, a generic completion message should be used instead of ATMCompletionAdvice.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMWithdrawalCompletionAdvice.name: ATM Withdrawal Completion Advice
ATMWithdrawalCompletionAdvice.definition: Information related to the completion of a withdrawal transaction on the ATM.
